sections.name: System Limit Settings
sections.description:
These settings control some program limits.
Changing any of these settings AFTER starting a new campaign IS NOT RECOMMENDED.

properties.name: MAX_NUMBER_PLAYER_MERCS
properties.description:
This is the max number of mercs you can recruit.
Player mercs, valid values 16 through 254, default is 40.

            PLEASE NOTE:
            Changing these settings may cause your savegames to become UNLOADABLE. Remember to change them before starting a new game!
            To load any "broken" savegames, simply revert to your original settings.			

            The maximum values (250+) are meant for debugging and stress testing. More sensible max values for gameplay are around 100.

properties.name: MAX_NUMBER_PLAYER_VEHICLES
properties.description:
This is the max number of vehicles you can recruit.
Player vehicles, valid values 2 through 6, default is 2.

            PLEASE NOTE:
            Changing these settings may cause your savegames to become UNLOADABLE. Remember to change them before starting a new game!
            To load any "broken" savegames, simply revert to your original settings.

properties.name: MAX_NUMBER_ENEMIES_IN_TACTICAL
properties.description:
Use this to adjust the numbers of enemies that can appear in the same sector in TACTICAL mode.
Enemies (i.e., soldiers), valid values 16 through 256, default is 64.

properties.name: MAX_NUMBER_CREATURES_IN_TACTICAL
properties.description:
Use this to adjust the numbers of creatures that can appear in the same sector in TACTICAL mode.
Creatures (i.e., bloodcats and crepitus), valid values 16 through 256, default is 64.

properties.name: MAX_NUMBER_MILITIA_IN_TACTICAL
properties.description:
Use this to adjust the numbers of militia that can appear in the same sector in TACTICAL mode.
Militia, valid values 16 through 256, default is 64.

properties.name: MAX_NUMBER_CIVS_IN_TACTICAL
properties.description:
Use this to adjust the numbers of civilians that can appear in the same sector in TACTICAL mode.
Civilians, valid values 16 through 256, default is 64.

properties.name: MAX_STRATEGIC_ENEMY_GROUP_SIZE
properties.description:
DO NOT LOWER ***MAX_STRATEGIC_ENEMY_GROUP_SIZE*** BELOW 20
This is used to determine how large a single group of enemies can be at any time, while moving on the strategic map.
Please note that if reinforcements are allowed (ALLOW_REINFORCEMENTS=TRUE), several such groups can combine together for an attack. However, they will split up at the first opportunity, trying to return to no more than this size.

properties.name: MAX_ITEM_SIZE
properties.description:
This is the maximum item size you can use in the game. It is possible, with enough attachments that lower a weapon size to change the weapon size to a huge number, since 0-1 = 255.
If any item with a size between 0 and MAX_WEAPON_SIZE s adjusted to a number bigger than MAX_ITEM_NUMBER, the item size will be 0. If the adjusted number is greater than MAX_WEAPON_SIZE but bigger than MAX_ITEM_NUMBER, MAX_WEAPON_SIZE will be set.
Values 0-65000, default is 34.

properties.name: MAX_WEAPON_SIZE
properties.description:
This is the maximum item size you want to use for weapons. All weapons will be between size 0 and MAX_WEAPON_SIZE regardless of attachments.
Values 0-32000, default is 9.

properties.name: OLD_INVENTORY_ITEM_NUMBER
properties.description:
This is used for items that will not appear in NIV.
Values 0-65535, default is 99.

properties.name: ALLOW_TARGET_HEADANDLEG_IFPRONE
properties.description:
ALLOW_TARGET_HEADANDLEG_IFPRONE is an experimental switch which allows targetting/hitting head/torso/legs for 
prone targets (until now, hits were always considered on torso). 
Additionally soldiers are no longer protected from stray bullets in crouched and prone stance. 
This switch will be removed once this code change has been accepted (or deemed unacceptable).

sections.name: Data File Settings
sections.description: In this section you can tell the program which Data Files to read. Mostly you can tell the program whether to use internal (hard-coded) settings, or external (XML) settings.

properties.name: USE_DIFFICULTY_BASED_PROF_DAT
properties.description:
Difficulty-based PROF.DAT

If FALSE, the game reads its profile data from the file called simply "PROF.DAT".
            If TRUE, the game reads its profile data from one of four different "PROF.DAT" files that are specific to the difficulty level of your current game. This allows using different character profiles depending on difficulty level.

properties.name: READ_PROFILE_DATA_FROM_XML
properties.description:
PROFEX (profile externalization)
These settings allow data about character profiles to be read (and written) from XMLs instead of PROF.DAT. These XMLs are called "MercProfiles.XML" and "MercOpinions.XML". Unlike PROF.DAT, they can be edited by hand.

            If TRUE, reads "MercProfiles.XML" and "MercOpinions.XML" for profile data.
            If FALSE, reads profile data from PROF.DAT.

            !!! Attention !!! If you want to play with the new trait system you have to set this to TRUE.

properties.name: WRITE_PROFILE_DATA_TO_XML
properties.description:
PROFEX (profile externalization)
These settings allow data about character profiles to be read (and written) from XMLs instead of PROF.DAT. These XMLs are called "MercProfiles.XML" and "MercOpinions.XML". Unlike PROF.DAT, they can be edited by hand.

            When TRUE, this setting writes profile data from memory to XML before the game's Main Menu is reached.
            This can be used to write all data from PROF.DAT directly into XML format. Make sure that READ_PROFILE_DATA_FROM_XML is set to FALSE before doing this, otherwise you're simple creating a duplicate of an XML you already have.

properties.name: USE_EXTERNALIZED_ENEMY_ITEM_DROPS
properties.description:
0 = Use default drop item system for enemies (and possibly also militia).
1 = Use the new drop item system from XML-Files (EnemyWeaponDrops.xml, EnemyAmmoDrops.xml, EnemyArmourDrops.xml, EnemyExplosiveDrops.xml, EnemyMiscDrops.xml) for enemies (and militia).

            INFO: This drop system only takes effect, if you have not choosen "Enemies Drop All Items" in the start new game screen.

properties.name: USE_XML_TILESETS
properties.description:
Tells the game to load ja2set.dat.xml (located in the MODs "Data" folder) instead of the old "BinaryData\ja2.set.dat" file
Must be TRUE if NUM_P_ITEMS (below) is > 3
If an xml file doesn't exist, setting the value to true will create one.
Issues have been reported using big maps with this value set to TRUE
Valid values = TRUE or FALSE, Default = FALSE

properties.name: NUM_P_ITEMS
properties.description:
Change the number of PItem graphics files used by the game
Requires using modified xml version of ja2set.dat for values > 3
This setting is also dependent on the items.xml file graphics tags, and the actual PItem graphics files
Do not change this unless you are modding the game, or it will probably break everything!
Issues have been reported using big maps with values > 3
Valid value range = 3-20, default = 3

sections.name: Backgrounds
sections.description: This section governs mercenary backgrounds.

properties.name: ENABLE_BACKGROUNDS
properties.description:
If TRUE, mercs have backgrounds.
		  
Backgrounds can add a range of bonuses, penalties, abilities and more.
Some of those are merely flavour, others are significant for making full use of some 1.13 features.
Default: TRUE

properties.name: ALTERNATIVE_IMP_CREATION
properties.description:
If TRUE, choices in skills/character traits/disabilities determine available backgrounds during IMP creation.
		  
- don't show backgrounds in selection whose tags would contradict with a main bonus/penalty been gained by chosen skill/character trait/disability
- gain additional background choices to make up for the possible loss in variety 
- those additional backgrounds are exclusive to this option (and the sub-option REDUCED_IMP_CREATION), won't show up without
- the additional backgrounds are also affected by the same rules as all others
- this will only affect IMP-backgrounds
- For more details see Backgrounds.xml 

Note: requires ENABLE BACKGROUNDS to be TRUE 
Default: FALSE

properties.name: REDUCED_IMP_CREATION
properties.description:
If TRUE, only use a reduced set of IMP backgrounds.

- only use the additional backgrounds from ALTERNATIVE_IMP_CREATION
- by default, that's considerably fewer than the usual amount of background choices, but should cover some essentials
- same consequences from choices in skills/character traits/disabilities as with ALTERNATIVE_IMP_CREATION
- this will only affect IMP-backgrounds
- For more details see Backgrounds.xml
Note: requires ALTERNATIVE_IMP_CREATION to be TRUE (shows no effect if not)
Default: FALSE

sections.name: Recruitment Settings
sections.description: In this section you can control various options regarding the recruitment of A.I.M, M.E.R.C, I.M.P and RPC mercenaries.

properties.name: IMP_MALE_CHARACTER_COUNT
properties.description: The maximum male I.M.P characers that are available. The total number is still limited by MAX_IMP_CHARACTERS.

properties.name: IMP_FEMALE_CHARACTER_COUNT

properties.name: IMP_MALE_4

properties.name: IMP_MALE_5

properties.name: IMP_MALE_6

properties.name: IMP_MALE_8

properties.name: IMP_FEMALE_1
properties.description: The first female I.M.P charcter in the file "prof.dat".

properties.name: IMP_FEMALE_2
properties.description: The second female I.M.P charcter in the file "prof.dat".

properties.name: IMP_FEMALE_3
properties.description: The third female I.M.P charcter in the file "prof.dat".

properties.name: IMP_PROFILE_COST
properties.description: This is the cost for creating an IMP character.

properties.name: DYNAMIC_IMP_PROFILE_COST
properties.description:
If this is set to TRUE, the IMP profile cost is multiplied by how many IMP characters you have generated
(i.e. the price of the second IMP character is doubled, of third character tripled etc.)

properties.name: IMP_INITIAL_POINTS
properties.description:
This is a TOTAL amount of points distributable between the attributes. This value reflects how good IMP character
you will be able to create. Default (vanilla) value is 500. Note that in the game, this value will be reduced by
5 * imp_min_attribute + 5 * imp_bonus_points_for_zero_attribute.

properties.name: IMP_MIN_ATTRIBUTE
properties.description: This is the lowest skill value you can have before it drops straight to 0.

properties.name: IMP_BONUS_POINTS_FOR_ZERO_ATTRIBUTE
properties.description: This is the amount of points that you receive when you a skill drops from IMP_MIN_ATTRIBUTE to 0.

properties.name: IMP_MAX_ATTRIBUTE
properties.description: This is the highest skill value you can get, for any skill, during IMP creation.

properties.name: IMP_STARTING_LEVEL_COST_MULTIPLIER
properties.description:
This value determines how many points you need to pay in order to increase your starting EXP Level during IMP creation.
It works as a multiplier for the EXP level you're trying to reach. The caluculation is:
EXP Level you want to reach * IMP_STARTING_LEVEL_COST_MULTIPLIER = points to pay.
You must pay separately for each increase!
(So if the value is 5: 1st to 2nd level costs 10 points, 2nd to 3rd level costs another 15 points, etc.)

properties.name: IMP_BONUS_POINTS_FOR_DISABILITY
properties.description: This value is how many points you get if you choose any disability for your IMP character (e.g. nonswimmer, claustrophobic).

properties.name: IMP_BONUS_POINTS_PER_SKILL_NOT_TAKEN
properties.description: You get this many bonus attribute points for every skill trait not taken at IMP creation time (e.g. TEACHER, KNIFING).

properties.name: EXPERTS_GET_DIFFERENT_CHOICES
properties.description:
If set to "TRUE", IMPs with expert traits will get different items than without expert traits.
There are additional entries for expert traits in the "TableData\IMPItemChoices.xml" file.

properties.name: MERC_WEBSITE_IMMEDIATELY_AVAILABLE
properties.description: Should the MERC website be available immediately at game-start?

properties.name: MERC_WEBSITE_ALL_MERCS_AVAILABLE
properties.description: This will allows you to hire any of the M.E.R.C characters as soon as the M.E.R.C website becomes available. It will also include any future MERC characters that are added.

properties.name: MERCS_CAN_BE_ON_ASSIGNMENT
properties.description: Mercs can be on assignment at the start of the game? Set to 1 and all the AIM mercs will be available to hire, set to 2 and all mercs will always be available. Set to 0 and you have JA2 Default behaviour.

properties.name: MERCS_CAN_DIE_ON_ASSIGNMENT
properties.description: If TRUE, allows a chance for A.I.M. and M.E.R.C. mercs to die while away on another assignment.

properties.name: SLAY_STAYS_FOREVER
properties.description:
If set to TRUE you can have Slay the terrorist for an unlimited time in your team. You also have to enable all the terrorists from the start new game screen.
For easy recruiting, just give Slay the disc you got from Carmen.

properties.name: SLAY_HOURLY_CHANCE_TO_LEAVE
properties.description: If SLAY_STAYS_FOREVER is set to FALSE this is the chance that Slay will leave if he is left alone in a sector.

properties.name: GEARKITS_ALWAYS_AVAILABLE
properties.description: On the A.I.M/M.E.R.C websites, a merc's gear kits are always available during the hiring process, even if they've been bought before.

properties.name: RECRUITABLE_SPECK
properties.description: If set to TRUE, Speck can be hired from MERC website. Hired, he'll no longer appear at Speck Com, but will comment on current situation from battlefield if able to (alive and well).

properties.name: RECRUITABLE_JOHN_KULBA
properties.description: If set to TRUE, Kulba (from Cleveland, Ohio) will appear on MERC website as a hireable merc some time after finishing escort tourists quest. He'll have his UB stats and voiceset (+JA2 specific lines).

properties.name: RECRUITABLE_JOHN_KULBA_DELAY
properties.description: How many days after escort quest can John Kulba appear on MERC website as a merc.

properties.name: RECRUITABLE_JA1_NATIVES
properties.description: If set to TRUE, JA1 native guides will appear on MERC website.

properties.name: MERC_BANKRUPT_WARNING
properties.description: If outstanding debt to MERC exceeds this, Speck will complain on the website.

properties.name: EARLY_REBELS_RECRUITMENT
properties.description:
Early Recruitment of Rebels - This enables recruiting Rebels earlier without the need to alter their .npc files.
Valid values are from 1 to 3 where:
1 = immediately after liberating Omerta
2 = having liberated 1, 2 or 3 towns depending on the "FACT_PLAYER_OWNS_x_TOWNS_INCLUDING_OMERTA" setting in the RPCs .npc file. If you use vanilla .npc files Miguel and Carlos will join after 3 towns liberated including Omerta
3 = vanilla behaviour - you must have liberated 3, 4, 5 towns including Omerta
4 = must have liberated Omerta and solved the "Deliver Food Quest" for Miguel

properties.name: SHOW_SKILLS_IN_HIRING_PAGE
properties.description: If set to TRUE, skills/traits will be shown as tooltip on merc portrait in both AIM and MERC hiring page

properties.name: MERCS_RANDOM_STATS
properties.description:
Should the game use random stats for the mercenaries (AIM, MERC, RPC, EPC and NPC)?
0 = do not use random stats (JA2 vanilla setting)
1 = full random stats for all profiles based on their "TableData\MercProfiles.xml" values
2 = partial random stats for any mercs that have random stats defined (Enabled = 1) in "TableData\RandomStats.xml"
3 = build random stats from (BaseAttribute) in "TableData\RandomStats.xml", range determined by level
Hardcoded formula for 3 is BaseAttribute + 4 * EXP + Random(9) + Random(8)
4 = full randomization of mercs, including traits, gear kits and all statistics

properties.name: MERCS_RANDOM_GEAR_KITS
properties.description:
This option only takes effect, if MERCS_RANDOM_STATS = 4.
Set this option to TRUE, so mercs (AIM and MERC) get random gear kits, otherwise they have their original kits.

properties.name: MERCS_RANDOM_BELL_DISTRIBUTION
properties.description: If set to TRUE, MERCS_RANDOM_BELL_DISTRIBUTION random values use bell-curve distribution. 'FALSE', use uniform distribution

properties.name: MERCS_RANDOM_STAT_RANGE
properties.description:
Applicable if MERCS_RANDOM_STATS = 1-2. Valid +/- range (0-50)
For example MERCS_RANDOM_STAT_RANGE = 10,
Stat = 80 will random between 70-90
Stat = 95 will random between 90-100 due to 100 maximum limit
Stat = 5 will random between 1-9 due to 1 minimum limit
Stat = 0/1/100 will not random

properties.name: MERCS_RANDOM_EXP_RANGE
properties.description:
Applicable if MERCS_RANDOM_STATS = 1-3. Valid +/- range (0-4)
For example MERCS_RANDOM_EXP_RANGE = 2,
Exp = 4 will random between 2-6
Exp = 8 will random between 7-9 due to 9 maximum limit
Exp = 2 will random between 1-3 due to 1 minimum limit
Exp = 1/9 will not random

properties.name: MERCS_RANDOM_START_SALARY
properties.description: Use random starting salaries for mercenaries based on their "TableData\MercProfiles.xml" values? (JA2 Vanilla setting = FALSE)

properties.name: MERCS_RANDOM_START_SALARY_PERCENTAGE_MAX_MODIFIER
properties.description: If MERCS_RANDOM_START_SALARY set to TRUE, MAX_MODIFIER is the allowed +/- random percentage range (0-100, default = 30)

sections.name: Financial Settings
sections.description: These settings adjust the various money-related features of the game, including mine income and militia costs.

properties.name: MERC_LEVEL_UP_SALARY_INCREASE_PERCENTAGE
properties.description: The percentage that a merc's salary rises each they go one experience level up, 0 = no raise, 100 is double salary

properties.name: MINE_INCOME_PERCENTAGE
properties.description:
Increases or decreases (by percentage) the amount of cash that mines generate every day.

100% = normal JA2 profits.
This value can be set as low as 1%. Setting it to 0 will automatically default to 1%, as otherwise it'll crash your game.
This value goes all the way up to 65535%, but that's not recommended.

properties.name: SELL_ITEMS_WITH_ALT_LMB
properties.description: If set to TRUE, this enables the ability to sell items from the sector inventory screen with ALT+LMB.

properties.name: SELL_ITEMS_PRICE_MODIFIER
properties.description:
If SELL_ITEMS_WITH_ALT_LMB is set to TRUE, this value is a divisor of the items value when you sell it with ALT+LMB.
For example, if you set this value to 4, you will sell the item for 25% of its original value (1/4).
Setting a value of 20 would mean 5% of the items value, and a value of 10 would mean 10%.
Valid ranges for PRICE_MODIFIER are -1 - 100.
0 = forces the system to dynamically adjust the Price Modifier based on game progress with greater progress resulting in a larger modifier.
-1 = works the opposite of 0. Greater game progress causes a smaller modifier resulting in greater income from selling later in the game.

properties.name: MILITIA_BASE_TRAINING_COST
properties.description: This is the cost of a single Town Militia (Green / Rookie) training session.

properties.name: MILITIA_COST_MULTIPLIER_REGULAR
properties.description: This is a multiplier for MILITIA_BASE_TRAINING_COST, used when promoting Green Militia to Regular Militia (Light-Blue Shirts).

properties.name: MILITIA_COST_MULTIPLIER_ELITE
properties.description:
This is a multiplier for MILITIA_BASE_TRAINING_COST, used when upgrading Regular Militia to Elite Militia (Dark-Blue Shirts).
ALLOW_TRAINING_ELITE_MILITIA must be set to TRUE for such an upgrade to even be possible.

properties.name: DAILY_MILITIA_UPKEEP_TOWN_GREEN
properties.description:
This is a daily upkeep cost for maintaining a single Town Militia man of Green level.
This cost is paid every midnight. If you can't afford to pay the whole amount, some (or all) militia will leave your service.
Only militia who have been in your service for 24 hours are paid!

properties.name: DAILY_MILITIA_UPKEEP_TOWN_REGULAR
properties.description:
This is a daily upkeep cost for maintaining a single Town Militia man of Regular level.
This cost is paid every midnight. If you can't afford to pay the whole amount, some (or all) militia will leave your service.
 Only militia who have been in your service for 24 hours are paid!

properties.name: DAILY_MILITIA_UPKEEP_TOWN_ELITE
properties.description:
This is a daily upkeep cost for maintaining a single Town Militia man of Elite level.
This cost is paid every midnight. If you can't afford to pay the whole amount, some (or all) militia will leave your service.
Only militia who have been in your service for 24 hours are paid!

properties.name: HELICOPTER_BASE_COST_PER_GREEN_TILE
properties.description: Cost for moving through sectors that are free of enemy SAM Site control.

properties.name: HELICOPTER_BASE_COST_PER_RED_TILE
properties.description: Cost for moving through sectors that are being controlled by an enemy SAM Site.

properties.name: HELICOPTER_HOVER_COST_ON_GREEN_TILE
properties.description: Cost for hovering in sectors that are free of enemy SAM Site control.

properties.name: HELICOPTER_HOVER_COST_ON_RED_TILE
properties.description: Cost for hovering in sectors that are being controlled by an enemy SAM Site.

properties.name: HELICOPTER_RETURN_TO_BASE_IS_NOT_FREE
properties.description: If TRUE, player will have to pay Skyrider even if he returns to base automatically - no more hovering until he runs out of fuel to save money.

properties.name: HELICOPTER_PAY_SKYRIDER_IN_BASE
properties.description: If TRUE, Skyrider will demand money only after safely landing in base.

properties.name: MINE_REQUIRES_WORKERS
properties.description:
If MINE_REQUIRES_WORKERS is TRUE, mine income also depends on the number or workers employed in a town. 
The maximum number of workers for each sector can be set in SectorNames.xml. 
For mine income, the total sum of all workers in a town are used, once a town employs it's maximum of workers, this modifier 
is at a 100%.

properties.name: WORKERRATE_PRESENT_INITIALLY
properties.description:
When we liberate a a sector for the first time, this is the rate of workers present. 
Values from 0.0 to 1.0.

properties.name: WORKER_TRAINING_COST
properties.description: the cost of training a single worker

properties.name: WORKER_TRAINING_POINTS
properties.description: the amount of worker training points needed to train a worker, the amount a trainer generates can be seen on their portrait

sections.name: Troubleshooting Settings
sections.description: In this section you can activate some features that may prevent bugs, or help overcome problems.

properties.name: DEAD_LOCK_DELAY
properties.description:
If an AI-controlled character becomes stuck, this is how many seconds will pass before the game decides to skip that character completely.
Do not set this too low, or you may end up skipping legitimate AI movement!
Time in seconds for DeadLock delay, default 15.

properties.name: ENABLE_EMERGENCY_BUTTON_NUMLOCK_TO_SKIP_STRATEGIC_EVENTS
properties.description: Skip global strategic events. This can be used to prevent game crashes. Press and hold NUMLOCK to skip the event.

properties.name: AUTO_SAVE_ON_ASSERTION_FAILURE
properties.description: Automatically try to save when an assertion failure occurs. Please submit the savegame with your bug-report.

properties.name: AUTO_SAVE_EVERY_N_HOURS
properties.description: Automatically save the game every N GAME-hours. 0 = disable.

sections.name: Graphics Settings
sections.description: In this section you can change video and graphics settings. These setting have no influence on game-play, they are purely visual.

properties.name: VERTICAL_SYNC
properties.description: If VERTICAL_SYNC is set to FALSE, the game will run faster.

properties.name: PLAYER_TURN_SPEED_UP_FACTOR
properties.description: Set the value to 1 for normal speed and 0 for maximum speed for the player's merc.

properties.name: ENEMY_TURN_SPEED_UP_FACTOR
properties.description: Set the value to 1 for normal speed and 0 for maximum speed for the enemies.

properties.name: CREATURE_TURN_SPEED_UP_FACTOR
properties.description: Set the value to 1 for normal speed and 0 for maximum speed for the creatues.

properties.name: MILITIA_TURN_SPEED_UP_FACTOR
properties.description: Set the value to 1 for normal speed and 0 for maximum speed for the militia.

properties.name: CIVILIAN_TURN_SPEED_UP_FACTOR
properties.description: Set the value to 1 for normal speed and 0 for maximum speed for the civilians.

properties.name: SCROLL_SPEED_FACTOR
properties.description:
Allows to modify scroll speed in tactical view.
Range: 0.5 - 2.0, default is 1.0

properties.name: USE_EXTERNALIZED_LOADSCREENS
properties.description:
Should the game use the externalized sector loadscreens?
If set to TRUE, the game will use the loadscreens defined in TableData\Map\SectorLoadscreens.xml.
If set to FALSE, the game will use the default loadscreen for the sectors, like in Vanilla JA2.

properties.name: USE_LOADSCREENHINTS
properties.description:
Show hints on the loadscreen?
If set to TRUE, the game will sho tips from in TableData\LoadScreenHints.xml.

properties.name: ADDITIONAL_DELAY_UNTIL_LOADSCREEN_DISPOSAL
properties.description:
This is the additional delay (in seconds) the loadscreen will be visible to read the loadscreen hints.
The delay will only be used if USE_LOADSCREENHINTS = TRUE

properties.name: USE_NEW_STARTING_GEAR_INTERFACE
properties.description: Use new starting gear interface on the AIM website, including 21 item view and up to 5 gearkits selection, if disabled classic style is used.

properties.name: RESTRICT_FEMALE_ENEMIES_EXCEPT_ELITE
properties.description:
Should the queen's army avoid recruiting Female soldiers?
If set to TRUE, female enemies will only occur as Elites in the army.

properties.name: SMALL_SIZE_PB
properties.description:
New thin progress bar in tactical interface for turns is drawn instead of the default one.
Default: FALSE

properties.name: AUTO_HIDE_PB
properties.description: Hide progress bar when cursor is on the top row of the map.

properties.name: HIDE_EXPLORED_ROOM_ROOF_STRUCTURES
properties.description: If set to TRUE, roof structures (e.g. sandbags) above explored rooms will be hidden at ground level view.

properties.name: RADAR_MAP_MODE_DAY
properties.description:
Immersion/flavour recolour of radar map (day) to simulate specific types of camera.
0 = No shading (vanilla)
1 = Infrared
2 = Night Vision

properties.name: RADAR_MAP_MODE_NIGHT
properties.description:
Immersion/flavour recolour of radar map (night) to simulate specific types of camera.
0 = No shading
1 = Infrared
2 = Night Vision
3 = Dark (vanilla)

properties.name: OVERHEAD_MAP_MODE_DAY
properties.description:
Immersion/flavour recolour of overhead map (day) to simulate specific types of camera.
0 = No shading (vanilla)
1 = Infrared
2 = Night Vision

properties.name: OVERHEAD_MAP_MODE_NIGHT
properties.description:
Immersion/flavour recolour of overhead map (night) to simulate specific types of camera.
0 = No shading (vanilla)
1 = Infrared
2 = Night Vision
3 = Dark

sections.name: Sound Settings
sections.description: In this section you can change sounds settings.

properties.name: WEAPON_SOUND_EFFECTS_VOLUME
properties.description:
Change this value to increase the volume for weapon sounds.

0 = No volume change for the weapon sounds
1000 = Maximum volume for the weapon sounds

properties.name: MAX_PERCENT_NOISE_SILENCED_SOUND
properties.description:
This parameter sets the threshold for using silenced weapons sounds. The weapon noise level has to be below this to play

sections.name: Tactical Interface Settings
sections.description:
In this section you can adjust the user-interface in TACTICAL screen.
Some of the new/altered interface may make the game easier or harder, depending on the settings you choose.

properties.name: REVEAL_DROPPED_ENEMY_ITEMS_AFTER_COMBAT
properties.description:
If this is set to TRUE, all items dropped by enemies during a battle will automatically be revealed at the end of combat (when all enemies are dead).
Otherwise, you have to actually walk past the dead enemy bodies for their equipment to be revealed.

properties.name: SHOW_BACKPACK_OWNER
properties.description: Show backpack owner's name on the ground and in taking items interface

properties.name: SHIFT_F_UNLOAD_WEAPONS
properties.description: Set this to FALSE to keep weapons loaded when SHIFT+F is pressed. Note that loaded weapon can be stolen by militia or enemy.

properties.name: SHIFT_F_REMOVE_ATTACHMENTS
properties.description: Set this to FALSE to keep item attachments when SHIFT+F is pressed. Unseparable attachments will not be removed.

properties.name: SMART_GOGGLE_SWAP
properties.description:
If set to TRUE, Shift-N will switch to best night vision goggles at night, and best sunglasses during the day.
If set to FALSE, whatever the merc is wearing will be switched with the best of the other kind (the "classic" behavior).

properties.name: GOGGLE_SWAP_AFFECTS_ALL_MERCS_IN_SECTOR
properties.description:
If set to TRUE, any automatic goggle swap (SHIFT-N or CTRL-SHIFT-N) will swap goggles for EVERY MERC IN THE SECTOR.
If set to FALSE, only mercs in the currently-selected squad are affected.

properties.name: AUTOMATICALLY_FLAG_MINES_WHEN_SPOTTED
properties.description:
If set to TRUE, when a character finds a mine they will automatically put a blue flag there without asking.
If set to FALSE, when a character finds a mine they will ask whether to put a blue flag there (the "classic" behavior).

properties.name: TIME_BOMB_WARNING
properties.description: If this is "TRUE", an animation will be played on the ground near any armed time bomb to warn the player of immediate danger.

properties.name: MINES_SPOTTED_NO_TALK
properties.description:
If set to TRUE, when a character finds a mine they will not say anything and only put a blue flag there or ask if they should do so.
(depends on the setting of "AUTOMATICALLY_FLAG_MINES_WHEN_SPOTTED")
If set to FALSE, when a character finds a mine they will tell you with a comment (the "classic" behavior).

properties.name: ITEMS_SPOTTED_NO_TALK
properties.description: If this is "TRUE" your merc won't says anything and won't stop when spotting an item in turn based mode.

properties.name: GRID_EXIT_IN_TURNBASED
properties.description:
If this is "TRUE", mercs can exit sector using grid exit in turn based mode, default behaviour.
This setting does not affect leaving sectors on map edges.

properties.name: STAND_UP_AFTER_BATTLE
properties.description:
If this is "TRUE", all mercs will stand up after the battle, which is the JA2 default behaviour.
If set to "FALSE", the mercs will not stand up after the battle.

properties.name: ALLOW_TACTICAL_MILITIA_COMMAND
properties.description:
If set to TRUE, allows giving abstract orders to Militia in tactical mode.
You can give commands to single militia by talking to them.
If your merc is wearing a headphone with whom you talk to the militia, you can give commands to ALL militia.

properties.name: USE_ENHANCED_DESCRIPTION_BOX
properties.description:
This determines where the Enhanced Description Box is used, instead of the "Classic" Description Box.
0 = Both Strategic and Tactical
1 = Strategic only
2 = Tactical only
You can switch EDB on and off using the in-game Options Menu.

properties.name: USE_NEW_BURST-AUTO_TARGETING_CURSORS
properties.description:
Enables new and improved "Chance-to-Hit" targeting cursors for Burst Fire and Auto Fire. Also adds "targeted bodypart" indicators to both.
0 = Use normal JA2 1.13 cursors.
1 = Use new Autofire and Burstfire cursors
2 = Use new Burstfire cursor only
3 = Use new Autofire cursor only

properties.name: SET_DEFAULT_AUTOFIRE_BULLETS_SMG
properties.description:
Set default number of autofire bullets:
0 = Max bullets allowed with max aiming
1..10 = Set default number of bullets

properties.name: SET_DEFAULT_AUTOFIRE_BULLETS_AR
properties.description:
Set default number of autofire bullets:
0 = Max bullets allowed with max aiming
1..10 = Set default number of bullets

properties.name: SET_DEFAULT_AUTOFIRE_BULLETS_MG
properties.description:
Set default number of autofire bullets:
0 = Max bullets allowed with max aiming
1..10 = Set default number of bullets

properties.name: INACCURATE_CTH_READOUT
properties.description:
When this is set to TRUE, it will change the way that the CTH Bar and "F" key feedback report our CTH.
Based on the characters' Experience Level, Wisdom, Marksmanship and Sniper Skill (if any), the program will decide how accurate our CTH feedback would be. An untrained character will see CTH jump between fewer "stations" than 100 (the normal). A very trained character will see the exact results.

properties.name: HIDE_BULLET_COUNT_INTENSITY
properties.description:
If this is set above 0, characters may sometimes forget how many bullets are left in their gun.
Depending on the character's Wisdom, Dexterity and Experience Level, he/she may be able to give an educated guess. Otherwise, the number of bullets left is completely hidden.
Increasing this value will make it harder to give an accurate bullet count during battle.
This feature only works when in turn-based TACTICAL mode. If the game switches to real-time, the true bullet count is displayed as normal.

properties.name: MAXIMUM_MESSAGES_IN_TACTICAL
properties.description:
Set how many messages can be displayed on-screen at the same time, in TACTICAL screen. The default is 6.
PLEASE NOTE: The actual maximum is based on your screen resolution:
640x480: Maximum is 20 lines.
800x600: Maximum is 26 lines.
1024x768: Maximum is 36 lines.
If the value is set higher than allowed for your current resolution, it is automatically decreased.

properties.name: TACTICAL_FACE_ICON_STYLE
properties.description:
If "Show Face gear graphics" is enabled in the option screen, you can choose from 4 different icon styles (Range: 0 - 3).
0 = Data\Interface\PORTRAITICONS_A.STI
1 = Data\Interface\PORTRAITICONS_B.STI
2 = Data\Interface\PORTRAITICONS_C.STI
3 = Data\Interface\PORTRAITICONS_D.STI

properties.name: SHOW_CAMOUFLAGE_FACES
properties.description:
If enabled, you see camouflaged portraits of your merc if they were any camo.
If no camouflaged portrait is available (Data\Faces\xxxCAMO folders), you see the standard face portrait.

properties.name: SHOW_ENEMY_HEALTH
properties.description:
Show health text when hovering the mouse over an enemy / creature.
0 - do not show
1 - show health as text
2 - show health bar
3 - show health + ap
4 - show health + ap + shock
5 - show health + ap + shock + morale
6 - show health + ap + shock + morale + bp

properties.name: SHOW_HEALTHBARSOVERHEAD
properties.description:
If enabled, you see the health and fatigue bar when hovering over your mercs, and on the currently selected merc.
Alt health bar additionally shows suppression shock level and current cover
0 - nothing
1 - default health bar
2 - alt health bar
3 - alt health bar + AP counter

properties.name: ENEMY_HIT_COUNT
properties.description:
How should the game display the enemy hit counter?
0 = Show damage inflicted as used to
1 = Show "?" as indicator if you scored a hit
2 = Do not show anything at all (If you scored a hit you need to tell by target's reaction)
3 = Show damage as white asterisks (scale is >0, >10, >30, >60, >100)
4 = Show damage as red asterisks

properties.name: PLAYER_HIT_COUNT

properties.name: SHOW_HIT_INFO

properties.name: ADDITIONAL_NCTH_CURSOR_INFO
properties.description:

0 = default cursor
1 = show enemy armour
2 = show armour, weapons and head items

properties.name: IMPROVED_NCTH_CURSOR
properties.description:
Visual improvements for NCTH cursor:
0 - default cursor
1 - improved cursor: show extended AP info, laser dot, scope mode icon, limit maximum displayed aperture size (100)
2 - compact cursor:  aiming level as numbers, limit displayed autofire bullets (10), limit maximum displayed aperture size (50)

properties.name: SHOW_SUPPRESSION_COUNT

light gray counter - suppression points from attack (they are calculated and shown after attack)
yellow - shock points from attack

0 = do not show
1 = show after damage counter

properties.name: ENABLE_EXT_MOUSE_KEYS
properties.description:
Additional mouse keys (and the "scrolling wheel") are enabled. Now we can use the mouse wheel to aim the weapon, toggle between merc-s or auto fire length.
Middle mouse button is used to look (= "L" key), alt + middle mouse button changes firing modes, alt + wheel change the stance.
4-th mouse button enables/disables the stealth mode.
Alt + 4-th mouse button reloads the weapon.
Mouse button 5 switches the cursor to roofs, alt + mouse button 5 enables climbing to roofs.

properties.name: USE_AIMED_BURST
properties.description:
Default: FALSE
The merc can now perform aimed burst fire and aimed auto fire.
Due to the reworked auto and burst penalties aimed auto-fire is less efficient then aimed burst for all guns. There is simply no use in firing more then 3 rounds due to low CtH od the last bullets. Aiming is performed by the mouse scrolling wheel.
ENABLE_EXT_MOUSE_KEYS must be set to TRUE for this option.
If mousewheel does not work for aiming, alternative method via [,] (comma) to increase aim.

properties.name: AIMING_BURST_PENALTY
properties.description:
Default: 2
The value is a multiplier for the auto fire penalty and burst penalty. Is needed to balance the aimed burst and aimed auto fire.
2 is an optimal recommended value.

properties.name: ASSIGN_SKILL_TRAITS_TO_ENEMY
properties.description:
This option determines if the game skill traits should also be available to enemies.

The system of assigning traits is rather sofisticated. It ensures the soldier's equipment match his skill traits, so an enemy with LMG will most probably have Auto Weapons trait (no way he can be a sniper for instance).
The actual chance the enemies/militia will gain a skill trait is based on:
1) Type of soldier (admin/regular/elite)
2) Current game progress
 3) Special equipment (for certain traits only)
4) ASSIGNED_SKILL_TRAITS_RARITY setting
5) Random factor

 Allowing the enemies to have traits can make the game signifficially harder (especially if using new trait system), as they will be more efficient with their weapons

properties.name: ASSIGN_SKILL_TRAITS_TO_MILITIA
properties.description:
This option determines if the game skill traits should also be available to militia.

The system of assigning traits is rather sofisticated. It ensures the soldier's equipment match his skill traits, so an enemy with LMG will most probably have Auto Weapons trait (no way he can be a sniper for instance).
The actual chance the enemies/militia will gain a skill trait is based on:
1) Type of soldier (admin/regular/elite)
2) Current game progress
3) Special equipment (for certain traits only)
4) ASSIGNED_SKILL_TRAITS_RARITY setting
5) Random factor

Allowing the enemies to have traits can make the game signifficially harder (especially if using new trait system), as they
will be more efficient with their weapons

properties.name: ASSIGNED_SKILL_TRAITS_RARITY
properties.description:
This option reduces/increases percentually the chance an enemy/militia will gain a skill trait.
You can enter values from -100 to 100.
Negative values represent lesser chance of assigning traits to non-merc soldiers.
Positive values represent bigger chance for traits to appear.

properties.name: ENABLE_CHANCE_OF_ENEMY_AMBUSHES

Enemy Ambushes
This setting allows a chance an enemy group ambushes player's squad.
The chance is based on many factors:
* Game difficulty.
* Whether you know if the enemy is there or not.
* How big the enemy group is (very large groups will not likely ambush you, smaller groups can ambush you more likely).
* Number of your mercs (meaning how easily the enemy can detect you soon enough to prepare for you. More mercs mean higher chance).
* Highest level amongst the mercs in your squad.
* Some other small circumstances.
* Finally the calculated chance is percentually multiplied by ENEMY_AMBUSHES_CHANCE_MODIFIER
